# bytesumcookies portfolio

> Personal portfolio website for Min-kyeong.
> This site presents projects, technical work, and learning records related to web development, API integration, deployment, and a security-oriented engineering path.

## Site Summary
This portfolio is built with Next.js and documents practical work around frontend implementation, backend/API integration, deployment, and project improvement.
The long-term goal behind this portfolio is to grow toward a security-oriented engineering role.

## Main Pages
- / : Home page and portfolio overview
- /about : Background, goals, technical direction, and personal introduction
- /projects : Main projects, implementation details, and tech stack
- /contact : Contact information and external links

## Key Topics
- Next.js portfolio development
- API integration
- Deployment and operation
- CI/CD automation
- SEO and metadata
- Security-oriented learning path

## Important Notes
- This website is a personal portfolio, not a commercial product.
- The main purpose of the site is to present technical work, project structure, and learning progress clearly.
- If you need the best overview, start with the home page and the projects page.
